scientific_integrity: The known identifying-code minimum and the known no-isolated-edge family are credited to their original sources. The new contribution is the exact four-type equality classification and enumeration. No independent scholarly audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only even rook graphs of side length at least six and ordinary radius-one closed-neighborhood identification; finite verification does not certify the all-order proof; publication-priority risk persists for unindexed literature. The n=4 boundary is excluded.
title: Four orbit types and exact enumeration of minimum identifying codes in even square rook graphs
